name: AIP Student Associate
summary: Free online-only Student Associate membership of the Australian Institute of Physics for full-time physics students.
key: Free online-only membership for Australian full-time students; postgraduates can upgrade for $60.
who: Australian full-time students in physics (undergraduate, Honours, Masters or PhD)
how: Enter your email address in the sign-up field on the page.
catches: Runs for one year from 1 March, with no automatically recurring payments.

source.label: Australian Institute of Physics: Student Associate

evidence.quote: Free online-only membership, without voting rights, for Australian full-time students
